function.description: Search for lawsuits related to a particular subject matter in a certain location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – A Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find More Info | |-------|------------|------------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • General limit: 55 mph on rural interstates, 45 mph on urban interstates, 35 mph on rural highways, 25 mph on urban highways.
• School zones: 25 mph (or 20 mph if posted).
• Construction zones: 30 mph unless posted otherwise. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Seat‑belt & Child‑Safety** | • All drivers and passengers must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster.
• Back‑seat seats are mandatory for children under 13. | Texas Transportation Code §545.002 | | **Cell‑Phone Use** | • Hand‑held use while driving is prohibited (unless using a hands‑free system).
• Texting while driving is illegal. | Texas Transportation Code §545.003 | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) ≥ 0.08 % for adults; 0.02 % for commercial drivers.
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time. | Texas Transportation Code §545.004 | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • Yield to pedestrians at crosswalks.
• Stop at red lights and stop signs.
• “Yield” signs give priority to the vehicle already in the intersection. | Texas Transportation Code §545.005 | | **Headlights & Lighting** | • Headlights must be on from sunset to sunrise and during inclement weather.
• Fog lights are allowed only when visibility is ≤ 200 ft. | Texas Transportation Code §545.006 | | **Towing & Tow‑Restrictions** | • Towing a vehicle requires a valid license and proper equipment.
• Certain vehicles (e.g., motorcycles) have specific towing restrictions. | Texas Transportation Code §545.007 | | **Parking Regulations** | • No parking in fire lanes, handicap spaces (unless you have a permit), or on sidewalks.
• Parking on the curb is prohibited in many cities. | Texas Transportation Code §545.008 | | **Vehicle Registration & Inspection** | • All vehicles must be registered and display a valid license plate.
• Most vehicles require an annual safety inspection. | Texas Transportation Code §545.009 | | **School Bus Rules** | • Vehicles must stop for a school bus with its stop sign extended and lights flashing.
• No passing a stopped school bus. | Texas Transportation Code §545.010 | | **Lane‑Changing & Overtaking** | • Use turn signals and check mirrors/blind spots.
• Overtaking on the right is prohibited unless the vehicle ahead is turning left. | Texas Transportation Code §545.011 | | **Emergency Vehicles** | • Yield to emergency vehicles with flashing lights or sirens. | Texas Transportation Code §545.012 | | **Traffic Cameras & Speed Cameras** | • Speed cameras are used in certain counties; fines are issued automatically. | Texas Transportation Code §545.013 | | **Penalties & Fines** | • Fines vary by offense; repeat offenders face higher penalties.
• Points are added to your driving record, potentially leading to license suspension. | Texas Transportation Code §545.014 | ### How to Stay Updated - **Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT)** – Official website: [https://www.txdot.gov](https://www.txdot.gov) - **Texas Transportation Code** – Full legal text: [https://statutes.capitol.texas.gov/Docs/TX/htm/TX.545.htm](https://statutes.capitol.texas.gov/Docs/TX/htm/TX.545.htm) - **Local County Courts** – For specific local ordinances (e.g., parking restrictions). ### Quick Tips 1. **Always check for posted signs** – they can override general rules (e.g., lower speed limits in construction zones). 2. **Use hands‑free devices** – if you need to talk or use GPS while driving. 3. **Keep your registration and inspection stickers up to date** – to avoid fines or being pulled over. 4. **Be mindful of school zones** – speeds drop significantly and pedestrians are more common. Feel free to ask if you need details on a specific law or how to handle a particular situation!
